entities.summary: Ronald Aldon Hicks is an American Catholic prelate who has served as the Archbishop of New York since 2026. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Chicago in Illinois from 2018 to 2020 and as Bishop of Joliet from 2020 to 2026.
